newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 26.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 87.78 points or 1.2 percent to close at a record 7345.91
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index rose 7.17 points or 0.67 percent to 1,078.20.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.4987/97 a dollar at around 0045 GMT, firmer from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Friday at 2.5012/22.
* Selective buying on blue chip stocks and recovery of smaller capitalised shares seen continuing, dealers said.
